clauses.text: Starting at an offset equal to the number of zeroes in finalBytes plus 1, copy all bytes in decodedBytes, up to decodedSize, starting at offset decodedOffset to finalBytes.

clauses.text: Set decodedBytes to an empty byte array that is the size of the final base-converted value. Calculate the size of decodedBytes by dividing log(sourceBase) by log(256) and then multiplying by the length of sourceEncoding minus the leading zeroes. Add 1 to the value of size.
clauses.actor: selected codec algorithm or alternative implementation
clauses.basis: Original u/64 component inverse ratio and bounded typed allocation proof; not public Multikey z or conflicting copy placement.

clauses.text: Set the baseEncodingPosition to size minus length. While the baseEncodingPosition does not equal size and the baseValue[baseEncodingPosition] does not equal 0, increment baseEncodingPosition. This step skips the leading zeros in the base-encoded result.
clauses.actor: selected codec algorithm or alternative implementation
clauses.basis: Frozen prose tests nonzero while its stated zero-skipping goal, Example18 and original selected source test zero.
clauses.completion_boundary: Authoritative interpretation or separately approved complete alternative-output contract; do not rewrite frozen prose.

clauses.text: Set baseValue to an empty byte array that is the size of the final base-expanded value. Calculate the final size of baseValue by dividing log(256) by log(targetBase) and then multiplying the length of bytes minus the leading zeroes. Add 1 to the value of size.
clauses.actor: selected codec algorithm or alternative implementation
clauses.basis: Original u/64 component, exact power-of-two log ratio and bounded typed allocation proof; not public Multikey z or full codec equivalence.
clauses.completion_boundary: Only the explicitly selected actor, branch and fixed publication; all other scope remains separate.

clauses.text: When an application is processing a controlled identifier document, if an @context property is not provided in the document or the terms used in the document are not mapped by existing values in the @context property, implementations MUST inject or append an @context property with a value of https://www.w3.org/ns/cid/v1 or one or more contexts with at least the same declarations, such as the Decentralized Identifier v1.1 context (https://www.w3.org/ns/did/v1).
clauses.basis: Actual no-context typed producer call and same-call final declaration injection; independent full context bytes have the CID publication digest. Other triggers and full JSON-LD/RDF remain separate.
clauses.completion_boundary: Only the explicitly selected actor, branch and fixed publication; all other scope remains separate.
